title: FrameRecord
description: One object frame of a measurement (OffAxisHolo draft 0.3). Embedded in ReconstructionResult.frames, where message_type and schema_version are omitted.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract (major.minor). This file defines 1.0.

used.description: True if the frame entered the average.

reject_reason.description: null for used frames; reason otherwise (also 'forced by min_frames: ...').

metrics.description: Per-frame metrics (saturated_count, sideband_fraction, piston_rad, phase_noise_rad, ...); NaN is sent as null.

acquisition.description: Acquisition settings and times passed through unchanged (exposure_us, frame_id, camera and host time).
